note: Triennial election of Coleraine Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Only Kilrea was contested ('a contest for only one of the 20 seats on Coleraine Rural - in Kilrea', Belfast Telegraph, 20 May 1964, p. 4); the other members were returned unopposed but are not named in the reports read. Council-meeting method: division inferred from the 1 June 1961 return (S. F. Hutchinson; Irish News, 17 May 1961, p. 7); the Irish News, 22 June 1964, p. 5 names Mr. S. F. Hutchinson as 'member for the area' of Castlerock at the council meeting of 20 June 1964, about two weeks after the election. No co-option or by-election in this division was found. Returned unopposed.
